title: Jacobian-Causal Memory Control for Persistent Memory in Language Model Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.08779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent-memory systems choose not only which records are retrieved but which prior information can alter current inference. We propose Jacobian-causal memory control (JCMC), which represents each authorized memory intervention by a predicted influence signature in a shared behavioral measurement space, selects interventions against a target effect and side-effect budget, and compares predicted with observed effects before retaining or rolling back the intervention. Under explicit smoothness and bounded-estimation assumptions, we prove a quadratic local-approximation bound, characterize the target effects reachable by a set of signatures, bound selection regret under signature error, and bound non-additive interactions between simultaneous memories. translated_title: 面向语言模型系统持久记忆的雅可比-因果记忆控制
translated_abstract: 持久记忆系统不仅要选择检索哪些记录，还要决定哪些先前信息能够改变当前的推理过程。我们提出雅可比-因果记忆控制（JCMC），该方法在共享的行为测量空间中用预测的影响签名来表示每个被授权的记忆干预，依据目标效应和副作用预算来选择干预措施，并在保留或回滚干预之前比较预测效应与实际观测效应。在明确的平滑性和有界估计假设下，我们证明了二次局部近似界，刻画了一组签名可达到的目标效应集合，在存在签名误差的情况下界定了选择遗憾，并对同时施加的多个记忆之间的非加性交互给出了界。本论文未报告任何基准测试结果；它定义了一个配对反事实估计器以及一套评估协议，用于将JCMC与基于相关性、图结构和策略过滤的检索基线进行比较。
tldr: 该论文提出雅可比-因果记忆控制（JCMC），通过预测影响签名、目标效应与副作用预算下的干预选择、以及预测-观测对比的保留或回滚机制，来控制持久记忆对语言模型当前推理的因果影响，并为其提供理论保证和反事实评估协议。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Jacobian-causal memory control (JCMC), which governs which persistent memories can causally alter a language model's current inference via predicted influence signatures, selection under target-effect and side-effect budgets, and predicted-versus-observed retention or rollback, backed by theoretical guarantees and a counterfactual evaluation protocol.
